_doc: Deck photo size and turns (contract/event-night-2026-10-16.md § 7). turn: quarter turns clockwise after turning `by` (-1 left, +1 right), always 0-3. size: the uploaded JPEG's size, longest side at most 2048 px (never upscaled), sides swapped for an odd number of turns.
